title: FUSE Unity Mod Manager Info.json
description: UMM manifest shape for the FUSE API mod and FUSE data packages.

AssemblyName.description: Required for code mods like FUSE. Omit for FUSE data-only packages if UMM accepts the folder.

Source.description: FUSE-specific provenance stamp used by the in-game update check to point an out-of-date player at the place they installed. The committed manifest ships "github"; the release flow re-stamps only the Nexus upload to "nexus". GitHub remains canonical for versioning.

FuseLoadPriority.description: FUSE-specific package ordering priority. Lower values load earlier; ties fall back to dependency order, then package id.

FuseLoadAfter.description: FUSE-specific data package ids that must load before this package.

FuseLoadBefore.description: FUSE-specific data package ids that must load after this package.

FuseDataFile.description: FUSE-specific pointer to one mod definition file in this UMM folder.

FuseDataFiles.description: FUSE-specific ordered list of definition fragments to load from this UMM folder.

FuseAssetPacks.description: FUSE-specific relative folder or folders containing Railroader AssetPack Runtime stores, for example SCAssetPacks.

EnableExperimentalEarlyScenePathSuppress.description: Experimental. Gates Unity async scene activation so world.suppressBaseScenePaths can be applied as early as Unity exposes scene objects. Disabled by default because a failed gate can wedge scene loading.

MirrorAssetPacksToLocalLow.description: Copies asset-pack folders to LocalLow before loading. Disabled by default; use only as a fallback for known-compatible asset packs.

VerboseApplyReportDetails.description: Writes per-object apply details to FUSE.log for package debugging. Disabled by default to keep public beta logs readable.

BlockNonHostMultiplayerClientWorldApply.description: Strict multiplayer safety switch. When true, non-host clients skip runtime graph/world/operations/progression mutation instead of using legacy-style compatibility mode.

ShowAdvancedHealthDetails.description: Shows advanced diagnostics across the FUSE menu pages such as asset duplicate winners, full asset store paths, registry internals, and advanced mod settings. Disabled by default to keep the public UI curated.

EnableUpdateCheck.description: On startup, asks GitHub whether a newer stable FUSE release exists and shows a non-blocking notice if so. Only a public list of release versions is fetched. Turning it off disables the automatic startup check; the manual /fuse.update console command still checks on demand.
